# Carcavelos Daily Briefing – Sunday, 13 September

**Tiny but clean – dawn patrol is your sweet spot.**

**Morning (04:23–11:00):** Expect 0.9m waves with light NNE winds staying offshore to light. Best window is **06:00–09:00** when conditions are glassiest and swell slowly builds from 0.66m to 0.76m. Water sits around 20°C – pleasant for early risers.

**Progression:** Winds turn around 11:00, switching to southerly and building through the afternoon. By 13:00 you're looking at light SW wind and slightly better 0.9m+ swell, but chop starts creeping in.

**Afternoon (12:00–17:00):** Waves hold steady at 0.92–0.94m but wind picks up to 12km/h W/WNW by 16:00. Still rideable, just less polished. Air temps climb to 28°C.

**Tips:** Go early – 06:00 start beats the wind switch. Bring a shortboard; waves stay waist-high all day. Crowd will be light in dawn patrol, heavy by lunch.
